topics.label: Cash flow and dashboard
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and want to understand how the cash flow control and dashboard work.
topics.answer: The dashboard shows income, expenses and balance in real time, with charts by period. Every cash entry (manual, from sales, or from paid/received bills) updates it instantly.

topics.label: Accounts payable and receivable
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and have questions about accounts payable and receivable.
topics.answer: You can register payables and receivables with due date, category and status, and the platform flags what's coming up. Marking one as paid/received updates your cash flow automatically.

topics.label: Taxes
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and want to know how the platform helps with tax control.
topics.answer: NexusFi organizes your tax control alongside the rest of your finances, so you can track deadlines and amounts without a separate spreadsheet.

topics.label: Inventory + Mercado Livre and marketplaces
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and want to understand the inventory integration with Mercado Livre and other marketplaces.
topics.answer: The inventory module tracks stock in and out and integrates with marketplaces — sales from there flow automatically into your cash flow and sales dashboard.

topics.label: Sales dashboard and pricing
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and have questions about the sales dashboard and the pricing calculator.
topics.answer: The sales dashboard groups what was sold by period and channel, and the pricing calculator helps set your sale price based on cost, fees and your target margin.

topics.label: Cost centers and reports
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and want to understand cost centers and reports.
topics.answer: You can organize expenses by cost center (department, project, etc.) and the platform generates automatic reports so you see where the money is going.

topics.label: Team, permissions and security PIN
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and want to know how team management, permissions and the security PIN work.
topics.answer: You can invite team members with permissions scoped by area, and sensitive actions require a security PIN — everything is logged with who did what and when.

topics.label: Plans, pricing and free trial
topics.message: Hi! I came from the NexusFi site and want to know more about the plans, pricing and free trial.
topics.answer: We offer a free trial so you can try the platform before subscribing. For current plans and pricing, check the Plans section on this page or talk to our team on WhatsApp.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Still have questions? Chat with us on WhatsApp or check the most common answers below.

items.question: Do I need a credit card to try it out?
items.answer: No. You get 7 days free on any plan, no credit card required.

items.question: How does the Mercado Livre and marketplaces integration work?
items.answer: Connect your marketplace account once, and every sale automatically flows into your cash flow, with fees and payouts already recorded.

items.question: Can I track accounts payable and receivable?
items.answer: Yes. You register due dates, categories and status for each account, get deadline alerts, and once marked as paid or received, the amount updates your cash flow right away.

items.question: Does the platform help with taxes like Brazil's DAS?
items.answer: Yes, tax tracking (Simples, DAS and similar) stays organized alongside the rest of your finances, with no need for a separate spreadsheet.

items.question: Can I invite my team to use the platform?
items.answer: Yes. You can invite team members with specific permissions per area, and sensitive actions require a security PIN, with a record of who did what and when.

items.question: Can I change plans after subscribing?
items.answer: Yes, you can switch plans or billing period (monthly or annual) at any time, directly from the platform.

items.question: Is my financial data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Access is protected by individual logins, role-based permissions and a PIN for sensitive actions, with everything audited.

items.question: How do I reach support if I run into an issue?
items.answer: You can open a support ticket right from the platform, in Settings, or talk to our team on WhatsApp anytime.
